from pathlib import Path
import re
print('=== Frontend concentration audit ===')
rows=[]
for path in Path('frontend/src').rglob('*'):
    if path.suffix not in {'.ts','.tsx'}: continue
    text=path.read_text()
    lines=text.count('\n')+1
    hooks=len(re.findall(r'\buse(?:State|Effect|Memo|Callback|Query|Mutation|Ref|Reducer)\b', text))
    api=len(re.findall(r'\b(?:fetch|apiClient|useQuery|useMutation)\b', text))
    rows.append((lines,hooks,api,str(path)))
for lines,hooks,api,path in sorted(rows, reverse=True)[:50]:
    print(f'{lines:4d} lines hooks={hooks:2d} apiSignals={api:2d} {path}')
